name: radiation: a rod made by a macro, thermal study with 200 °C at one end and radiation from the other; the PM offers emissivity
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const fld = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no field ' + k); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; await m.actions.ensureKernel(); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); const r = await m.macro.runMacro(['await mm.newDocument("part");', 'const s = await mm.sketch("right", [{ rect: [10, 10] }]);', 'await mm.extrude(s, 100);'].join('\n')); await sleep(500); await m.run('simulation'); await sleep(300); m.actions.pmSet('study', 'thermal'); await sleep(200); const e = m.state.editing; const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const planes = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })).filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const byX = planes.sort((a, b) => a.f.center.x - b.f.center.x); const mk = (x) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: 'PLANE' }); e.fixtures = [mk(byX[0])]; e.loads = [mk(byX.at(-1))]; e.temperature = 200; m.actions.pmSet('heatKind', 'radiation'); await sleep(200); const hasEps = Boolean(q('[data-pm-field="emissivity"]')); fld('emissivity', 0.9); await sleep(100); fld('ambient', 20); await sleep(100); window.__radX = [byX[0].f.center.x, byX.at(-1).f.center.x]; return JSON.stringify({ macro: r.ok, hasEps, eps: e.emissivity, kind: e.heatKind, span: Math.round(byX.at(-1).f.center.x - byX[0].f.center.x) }); })()

name: radiation: the run gives the end temperature of the 1D balance and lists the radiated heat
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const fld = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no field ' + k); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; const e = m.state.editing; e.elementSize = 3; await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); await sleep(500); const r = e.result; const SIG = 5.670374419e-8; const k = r.conductivity; let lo = 20, hi = 200; for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) { const mm = (lo + hi) / 2; const f = (k * (200 - mm)) / 0.1 - 0.9 * SIG * ((mm + 273.15) ** 4 - 293.15 ** 4); if (f > 0) lo = mm; else hi = mm; } const Ts = (lo + hi) / 2; const xEnd = Math.max(...window.__radX); let s = 0, n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < r.model.nn; i++) if (Math.abs(r.nodes[3 * i] - xEnd) < 1e-6) { s += r.nodeTemperature[i]; n++; } const end = s / n; const text = q('.left-pm-body').textContent; return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, matches: Math.abs(end - Ts) < 0.01 * (200 - Ts), radiated: r.radiationOut > 0, listed: /복사로 나간 열|Heat radiated/.test(text) }); })()
